insights.summary: Wants QM to score schedulers on whether they offered the earliest available appointment.
insights.quote: I want QM to score our schedulers on whether they offered the earliest available appointment. That's the metric my board looks at.

insights.summary: Signal Discovery found a third of cardiology calls were parking/directions questions; landing page fix halved them.
insights.quote: Signal Discovery found that a third of our cardiology calls were people asking about parking and directions. We fixed the landing page and those calls dropped by half.

insights.summary: Legal requires role-based access so only compliance can see unredacted transcripts before expansion.
insights.quote: Before we expand to the other twelve clinics, legal wants role-based access, so only compliance can see an unredacted transcript.
